question: How did NVIDIA's automotive revenue perform in Q4 FY25, and which major automaker partnership was announced during this period?
answer: NVIDIA's automotive revenue increased 103% year-over-year to $570 million in Q4 FY25, while announcing that Toyota, the world's largest automaker, will build its next-generation vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Orin running the safety-certified NVIDIA DriveOS operating system.
